name: Niger Delta
description: Tertiary deltaic province; Africa's largest petroleum system with >37 bn bbl and ~200 tcf reserves. Extends into Cameroon's Rio del Rey and Equatorial Guinea's Bioko deepwater (Zafiro/Alba).
notes: Area includes onshore delta, shelf and deepwater fan.

name: Benin (Dahomey) Basin
description: Transform-margin basin from the Volta delta to western Nigeria; hosts Sèmè (Benin, shut-in), Aje (Nigeria) and Ghana's Keta sub-basin.

name: Anambra Basin
description: Cretaceous inland basin north of the Niger Delta; gas-prone with limited commercial development.

name: Chad (Bornu) Basin – Nigerian sector
description: Nigerian portion of the Lake Chad rift system; NNPC frontier exploration (Kolmani discoveries in the adjacent Gongola/Benue basin, 2019).

name: Termit / Agadem Rift Basin
description: Cretaceous–Paleogene rift basin in eastern Niger; Agadem block produces ~110 kb/d (SORAZ refinery + Niger–Benin export from 2024).

name: Doba Basin
description: Cretaceous rift basin in southern Chad; heavy crude from Komé, Miandoum, Bolobo, Nya, Moundouli etc. exported via the Chad–Cameroon pipeline since 2003.

name: Bongor Basin
description: Rift basin SE of N'Djamena; CNPC's Ronier/Mimosa/Prosopis fields feed the Djermaya refinery and export via Komé.

name: Doseo–Salamat Basins
description: Cretaceous strike-slip basins of SE Chad (Central African Shear Zone); Mangara/Badila discoveries (Doseo) produce via Komé.
notes: PetroChad (Mangara) assets sold by Glencore to Perenco (2024).

name: Lake Chad Basin – Chadian sector
description: Northern Chad rift blocks (Lake Chad, Erdis); frontier.

name: Rio del Rey Basin
description: Cameroonian extension of the Niger Delta; ~80% of Cameroon's oil (Perenco RDR, Addax/Sinopec).

name: Douala / Kribi–Campo Basin
description: Aptian-salt Atlantic margin basin; gas (Sanaga Sud, Logbaba, Etinde) and oil (Ebome, Bolongo, Mvia).

name: Rio Muni Basin
description: Mainland Equatorial Guinea margin; Ceiba/Okume complex (Block G) and Aseng/Alen (Blocks I/O).

name: Gabon Coastal Basin (North & South Gabon sub-basins)
description: Aptian-salt passive-margin basin; Rabi-Kounga, Gamba, Etame, Dussafu, Ezanga. Pre-salt and deepwater (Anton/Diaba) prospective.

name: Interior (Syn-rift) Gabon Basin
description: Inland Cretaceous rift; limited exploration.

name: Lower Congo Basin (Congo Fan / Cabinda–Congo coastal)
description: Core West African salt basin: Angola Blocks 0, 14, 15, 17, 18, 31, 32; Congo's Moho/Nkossa/Marine XII; DRC's Muanda coastal fields.
notes: Includes Congo Fan ultra-deepwater (Block 32 Kaombo; Block 31 PSVM).

name: Kwanza Basin
description: Pre-salt/Post-salt basin south of Luanda; Cameia–Golfinho (Block 20/11, TotalEnergies FID 2024) and Quiluma/Maboqueiro gas (Block 1/14).

name: Benguela Basin
description: Southern Angolan salt basin; limited discoveries.

name: Namibe Basin
description: Frontier basin straddling the Angola–Namibia border; ExxonMobil, TotalEnergies, Chevron licences (2019–2024).

name: Cuvette Centrale (Congo Basin)
description: Vast intracratonic basin; DRC's 2022 auction largely failed, relaunched 2025 (52 blocks). No commercial discoveries.

name: DRC Coastal (Bas-Congo) Basin
description: DRC's only producing area (Perenco Muanda; ~20–25 kb/d onshore/offshore).
notes: Part of the Lower Congo Basin.

name: Albertine Graben – DRC sector
description: DRC side of Lake Albert; Blocks I–V relicensed 2022–2025.

name: Tano / Cape Three Points Basin
description: Cretaceous transform-margin basin; Jubilee, TEN, Sankofa-Gye Nyame (Ghana) and Baleine, Calao (Côte d'Ivoire).

name: Ivorian (Abidjan–San Pedro) Basin
description: Foxtrot/Marlin gas (CI-27), Espoir (CI-26), Baobab (CI-40) and Baleine deepwater.
notes: Western part continuous with Tano basin.

name: Saltpond (Central) Basin
description: Ghana's first producing field (Saltpond, 1978) decommissioned 2019–2021.

name: Voltaian Basin
description: Neoproterozoic intracratonic basin; GNPC-led onshore exploration (seismic, 2018–2024).

name: MSGBC Basin – Senegal sector
description: Mauritania–Senegal–Gambia–Bissau–Conakry basin; Sangomar (first oil 2024), GTA LNG (2025), Yakaar-Teranga (25 tcf, undeveloped).
notes: Area is the whole MSGBC; Senegal portion ~ 60,000 km².

name: Sirte Basin
description: Libya's principal province (~80% of reserves): Waha, Sarir, Messla, Nafoora, Amal, Bu Attifel, Zelten/Nasser, Intisar.

name: Murzuq Basin
description: Paleozoic basin in SW Libya; El Sharara (NC-115/NC-186) and El Feel (NC-174).

name: Ghadames / Berkine Basin
description: Paleozoic–Triassic basin: Algeria's Berkine (Hassi Berkine, Ourhoud, El Merk, MLE), Libya's Wafa, Hamada NC-7, Area 47 / Erawin.

name: Illizi Basin
description: Paleozoic gas province: In Amenas, Tin Fouyé Tabankort, Alrar, Ohanet.

name: Oued Mya / Triassic Province (Hassi Messaoud – Hassi R'Mel)
description: Cambrian–Triassic province hosting Algeria's two giants: Hassi Messaoud (oil) and Hassi R'Mel (gas).

name: Ahnet – Gourara – Timimoun Basins
description: South-west Algerian gas basins: In Salah, Timimoun, Touat, Ahnet (tight gas).

name: Reggane Basin
description: Reggane Nord gas project (2017; Sonatrach/Repsol/Wintershall Dea/Edison).

name: Béchar – Tindouf Basins
description: Western Algerian frontier basins offered in 2024 bid round.

name: Pelagian / Offshore Tripolitania Basin
description: Offshore NW Libya: Bouri (oil), Bahr Essalam (gas), Structures A&E (under development), Al Jurf.

name: Cyrenaica Platform & Offshore
description: NE Libya frontier; NOC 2025 licensing round includes offshore Cyrenaica blocks.

name: Kufra Basin
description: Paleozoic frontier basin in SE Libya / NE Chad (Erdis); no commercial discoveries.

name: Nile Delta & Mediterranean Deepwater
description: Egypt's gas heartland: Zohr (Shorouk), WDDM, West Nile Delta, Atoll, Nooros, Baltim; includes Levantine/Herodotus deepwater.

source.name: EGAS / USGS Nile Delta Basin Province

name: Western Desert (Abu Gharadig, Shushan/Matruh, Faghur)
description: Cretaceous–Jurassic rift basins; Khalda (Apache), Meleiha (Eni), Badr El Din/Obaiyed (Cheiron), Abu Gharadig.

name: Gulf of Suez
description: Mature Miocene rift province: Belayim, Morgan, July, Ramadan, October, Zeit Bay.

name: Egyptian Red Sea
description: 2019 Red Sea bid round (Chevron, Shell, Mubadala); no discoveries yet.

name: Upper Egypt (Beni Suef – Kom Ombo)
description: Small Nile Valley oil fields (Kom Ombo/Al Baraka, Beni Suef).

name: Orange Basin
description: Cretaceous passive-margin basin; Namibia's Venus (2022), Graff/Jonker (2022–23), Mopane (2024), Capricornus (2025); South Africa's Kudu gas and Blocks 2B/3B/4B, DWOB.

name: Lüderitz Basin
description: Frontier basin north of the Orange; limited drilling.

name: Walvis Basin
description: Northern Namibian margin (Wingat, Murombe wells); frontier.

name: Kavango (Owambo) Basin
description: Onshore frontier (ReconAfrica PEL 73, 2021–2025 wells); no commercial discovery.

name: Outeniqua Basin (Bredasdorp, Pletmos, Gamtoos, Algoa)
description: South Coast; F-A/E-M gas (depleted, GTL idle), Oribi/Oryx oil (decommissioned), Brulpadda/Luiperd (Block 11B/12B, undeveloped).
notes: Status 'operational' reflects licensed infrastructure; production currently minimal.

name: Durban / Zululand (East Coast) Basins
description: East-coast frontier (ERA/Eni licences).

name: Karoo Basin (shale gas)
description: Permian shale gas play; exploration rights stalled by regulation and litigation.

name: Kandi Basin
description: Onshore northern Benin frontier (Block B, Elephant Oil).

name: Iullemmeden Basin
description: Western Niger frontier (Kafra, Bilma blocks); no commercial discovery.
